metadata.name: experience-presets-customize-draft
metadata.description: Given the complete phone Customize editor in an isolated browser and routed storage lease, when physical bands, browser preview preference, freshness, fallback and Load thresholds are saved as drafts, then each draft restores independently without selecting a policy.

metadata.label: Edit physical bands, preview preference, freshness and load draft controls without selecting a policy

assert.failure_message: Customize must keep physical effect and browser motion choices independent, persist freshness/fallback/load drafts locally, and restore each selected preset draft.

metadata.label: Require complete independent Customize draft persistence
